linework.observation: Bold continuous contours define the bunk frame, storage, letter and protagonist, matching canonical character and interior references.

colour.observation: Restrained navy, steel, warm skin and cream; a localized red caged lamp does not wash the frame.

shading.observation: Soft cel shadows on the bunk, face and coveralls; metal highlights remain illustrated.

character_construction.observation: Bald rounded head, nose, ears, brows and mouth match the established protagonist.

backgrounds.observation: Compact berth with lockers, solid steel bulkhead and no exterior window; submarine setting reads clearly.

finish.observation: Clean polished image with clear focal point and no unintended legible retirement text.

identity.observation: The protagonist remains bald and wears level-one navy coveralls.

content.observation: A family letter and bunk are shown in a sealed interior; the porthole and unrelated retirement folder are gone.

composition.observation: Seated figure and bunk are fully framed with margin; readable narrow room depth.

regions.people_faces: Single bald protagonist reading a letter, with a subdued expression.
regions.clothing: Dark navy coveralls with restrained details.
regions.foreground_props: Letter, family photographs, bunk pillow and compact locker.
regions.architecture: Metal bunk frame, storage doors and solid bulkhead panels.
regions.distance: Locker and bunk structure create confined interior depth.
regions.lighting: Warm caged practical lamp with subdued shadows and limited red cast.
